name: Net Asset Value Calculation
definition: Calculation of the net asset value for an investment fund/fund class.

ValuationDateTime.name: Valuation Date Time
ValuationDateTime.definition: Date and time of the price valuation for the investment fund/fund class.

NetAssetValue.name: Net Asset Value
NetAssetValue.definition: Value of all the holdings, less the fund's liabilities, attributable to a specific investment fund class.

ValuationType.name: Valuation Type
ValuationType.definition: Specifies how the valuation is done, based on the schedule stated in the prospectus.

SuspendedIndicator.name: Suspended Indicator
SuspendedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the valuation of the investment fund class is suspended.

ForExecutionIndicator.name: For Execution Indicator
ForExecutionIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the price information can be used for the execution of a transaction.

OfficialValuationIndicator.name: Official Valuation Indicator
OfficialValuationIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the valuation is an official valuation.

EstimatedPriceIndicator.name: Estimated Price Indicator
EstimatedPriceIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the price is an estimated price.

DeclarationChannel.name: Declaration Channel
DeclarationChannel.definition: Means of the net asset value publication, for example, a newspaper.

DeclarationDate.name: Declaration Date
DeclarationDate.definition: Date/time of the net asset value publication.

FirstValuationDate.name: First Valuation Date
FirstValuationDate.definition: Date on which the investment fund class was first priced.

HistoricPricingIndicator.name: Historic Pricing Indicator
HistoricPricingIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the price is historic or forward.

RelatedFund.name: Related Fund
RelatedFund.definition: Specifies the fund for which the NAV is calculated (per fund unit).

TaxLiability.name: Tax Liability
TaxLiability.definition: Information related to taxes that are due.

TaxRefund.name: Tax Refund
TaxRefund.definition: Information related to taxes that are paid back.

ValuationStatistics.name: Valuation Statistics
ValuationStatistics.definition: Information related to the price variations of an investment fund class.

InvestmentFundPerformanceFactors.name: Investment Fund Performance Factors
InvestmentFundPerformanceFactors.definition: Factors that give indications about the performance of a fund.

Price.name: Price
Price.definition: Price derived from the net asset value.

SecuritiesQuantity.name: Securities Quantity
SecuritiesQuantity.definition: Quantity on which the NAV is calculated.

Interest.name: Interest
Interest.definition: Interest that has accumulated between the most recent payment of interest and the sale of the financial instrument.

FundsCashFlow.name: Funds Cash Flow
FundsCashFlow.definition: Net cash flow for a valuation date, which is incorporated in the NAV.
